groups.title: Cats and Creatures
groups.theme: The August cats, black and boxy, standing in striped rooms; then flat single creatures, each one color on one color.

groups.title: Crowns and Last Masks
groups.theme: Crowned masks, then the last packed faces of September and the three works minted on Oct 15, 2022.

groups.title: Portraits
groups.theme: Heads that look like people: hats, hair, worried eyes, plain line drawings, and skulls lit by colored beams.
